messages:
alex: FYI prospect (RegulatoryBank EU) wants a 2-week technical POC: strict EU data residency, explicit list of region-specific sub-processors, and clear routing policy for failover behavior (they want deny-by-default unless we get explicit approval). They also asked for a price delta for a short Dedicated pool vs hosted with geo-fallback and a note on potential egress fees. cc @tess @nora

tess: Noted. Please share SAML org id + expected qps and avg sequence so I can price Dedicated. Also want to know if they need KMS HSM.

alex: SAML id RB-EU-101. Traffic: 30 rps steady, 200 rps spike windows (1-2m), avg gen ~600 tokens. HSM: they indicated preference but will confirm.

nora: Legal: we can do SCCs + subproc appendix. For hosted we have an "EU-only telemetry" toggle but it disables automatic cross-region fallback. If they insist on deny-on-failover we can configure routing accordingly but that increases outage risk. Need ops to confirm which monitoring vendors are EU-only tenants.

mike: Ops summary:
- Dedicated/Private: can pin compute, storage, logs to eu-west-1 or eu-central-1; no outbound replication unless requested.
- Hosted: control-plane metadata may route to global analytics; enable eu-only-telemetry to keep control-plane data in EU (tradeoff: disables cross-region failover).

mike: Draft routing policy snippet we can include in runbook:
```yaml
routing:
  primary_region: eu-west-1
  failover_region: none
  failover_policy: deny
  telemetry_scope: eu-only
  subprocessor_disclosure: region_granular
```

mike: If they want a canary-style manual failover we can add `failover_region: eu-central-1` but keep `failover_policy: manual_approval` so traffic won't automatically leave EU without ops signoff.

ops-bot: Provisioning note: estimated Dedicated short-term (2-week) 4xA100 pool = "€6.2k/week" (includes warm-up). Hosted w/ geo-fallback estimated token & throughput run-rate ~ "€2.7k/week" + potential egress ~ "€0.5-1.2k/week" depending on volume. These are ballparks pending exact token counts.

security-bot: Draft sec answer for Q10: "Dedicated & Private: logs/traces retained in customer-selected EU region; no replication outside EU unless customer explicitly enables it. Hosted: control-plane telemetry is global by default; EU-only telemetry option is available but will prevent automatic cross-region failover. Details: https://redwood-internal/security/telemetry-routing"

nora: Two legal follow-ups: (1) confirm whether Datadog/AWS/GCP EU tenants are acceptable; (2) if HSM KMS required, timeline slips ~2-3 weeks for integration. Please flag in the quote.

alex: Next steps: 1) Tess: draft quote with both options and callouts re: egress & HSM impact; 2) Mike: short runbook showing manual failover steps and EU-only telemetry enablement; 3) Nora: subproc appendix + SCCs and conditional clause for telemetry location. I'll combine and send to RegBank by EOD. :thumbsup:
